newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tyson cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tyson cut to hold.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she downgraded poultry producer Tyson Foods Inc to a hold from a buy.

-- She also cut her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Tyson to $0.85 a share from $1.00. The third quarter 1997 estimate was cut to $0.19 from $0.26 and the fourth quarter was lowered to $0.24 from $0.33.

-- She reduced her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $1.20 a share from $1.45. She lowered her first quarter 1998 earnings estimate to $0.23 a share from $0.33; second quarter to $0.27 from $0.35; third quarter to $0.34 from $0.38 and fourth quarter to $0.36 from $0.39.
-- On Thursday, Tyson said it did not expect to meet Wall Street's earnings forecasts for the third quarter because of operating and margin pressures.

-- Tyson said its margins were under pressure because of earlier disruptions in its Russian shipments and lower-than-expected prices overall, particularly for leg quarters and related dark meat products.

-- In a report, Wittenburg said she downgraded Tyson and lowered estimates "due to worries about the Russian situation, the longevity of the situation and the spillover impact of pricing on to world markets."
-- Tyson shares were off one at 20-9/16.
